description: MetaRalph Phase 9: Autonomous Deployment - CI/CD integration, environment management, deployment automation, rollback on failure.

userStories.title: Create deployment configuration model
userStories.description: As a user, I need to configure how each project should be deployed.
acceptanceCriteria: Config includes: provider, environment, branch, commands, healthCheck
Stored per-project in projects.deployConfig JSON column

userStories.title: Implement deployment provider integrations
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to deploy to various cloud providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Implementations: VercelProvider, NetlifyProvider, RailwayProvider, FlyProvider, CustomProvider
Each provider implements: deploy(), getStatus(), rollback(), getLogs()
Uses provider CLIs or APIs (vercel, netlify, railway, flyctl)

userStories.title: Implement staging deployment flow
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to deploy completed PRDs to staging automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Only deploys if project has deployConfig with staging environment
Waits for deployment to be live

userStories.title: Implement production deployment with approval
userStories.description: As a user, I need to approve production deployments explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates deployment approval request in queue
Shows: changes summary, staging test results, rollback plan
Deployment includes automatic rollback on failure

userStories.title: Implement deployment rollback
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to automatically rollback failed deployments.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-rollback triggers on: health check failure, error rate spike
Notifies user of rollback with reason
Creates incident report for failed deployment

userStories.title: Implement deployment CLI and dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I need to view and manage deployments from CLI and dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows: DeploymentsView with history, status, actions
